model_description.spinup: June–December 1999; source describes six months. Not part of admitted statistics.
model_description.validation_interpolation: 5 m vertical × 4 km horizontal triangular linear interpolation, model bathymetry; mooring transport confined between nearshore and offshore moorings.
model_description.transect_method: Cross-shelf/slope sections locally perpendicular to 250 m contour; Figure 3 does not supply numeric endpoints here.
model_description.raw_model_access: 2026-10-09 explicit request timed out; no raw fields acquired.
model_description.relaxation_note: Surface SST/SSS relaxed to daily HYCOM. Mean sea level not relaxed. HYCOM also supplies open-boundary fields; no inference of a freely evolving closed model budget.
